overview: Step onto the podium as young conductors face the London Symphony Orchestra in a high stakes battle to prove they can become a maestro.
title: Making a Maestro

overview: The ABC Afterschool Special is an American television anthology series that aired in the late afternoon on week days. Most episodes were dramatically presented situations, often controversial, of interest to children and teenagers. Several episodes were either in animated form or presented as documentaries. Topics included illiteracy, substance abuse and teenage pregnancy. The series won 51 Daytime Emmy Awards during its 25-year run. In 2004 and 2005, BCI Eclipse and Sunset Home Visual Entertainment issued six DVD collections of episodes from the series that had been produced by Martin Tahse, each collection containing four episodes. A boxed set, in the shape of a school bus, was also released containing all of the DVD releases, with a detailed information booklet of all the specials on the set and including an extra DVD of two specials that had previously not been released on DVD. The DVDs are currently out of print.
title: The ABC Afterschool Special

overview: What is a good life? Rose is a brilliant scholarship holder at Sudruethai School, an institution with many connections that can make her go to a good school ranking in the future. However, when Rose stepped into this school, she realized that in order to get a good life in this country, money is everything. Everything revolves around money and parental connections. The one who uses it so much is Lily, the school queen, whose father is one of the members of the Parents' Association. Rose, a scholarship student who was pulled into the last chain of this school, had to get up, "robbing and taking back what students deserve" alongside Surf, a quiet but clever scholarship student and Boo, a crazy Taekwondo athlete.
title: Get Rich

overview: The legend of a secret town shrouded in a curtain of fog, a mountain village of only women and golden turmeric, and a ceremonial hunt for the survival of their lineage.
title: Laplae The Hidden Town

overview: Michael Portillo gives tips on enjoying a stay in the Swedish capital of Stockholm for a mid-winter expedition, brimming with Nordic hospitality and adventure.
title: Michael Portillo in Stockholm

overview: After the assassination attempt, Captain Vitaly Tumansky is determined to find the culprits at any cost. But at the same time, he has to deal with routine matters and learn to work with his new partners — Senior Lieutenant Suvorova and the local police officer, who recently arrived in Moscow from the North.
title: Капитан Туман

overview: After Thee and Peach's wedding, Thee resolves to finally get a grip. First, he takes Peach on six consecutive months of honeymoons, forcing Peach to ask for time off work. Meanwhile, Rome has to take over as leader of Arseni, and Thee turns his focus to his work at GMM THEE V
title: Peach and Me

overview: Ridiculousness and Rob Dyrdek return with another incredible season of hysterical and absurd internet videos. Sterling "Stee-Lo" Brim and Chanel "West Coast" join Rob and another unbelievable line up of special guests, including rapper phenom Future, R&B singer/ songwriter Ne-Yo, and internet video super-team Smosh. This season's storm of new categories like "Power Kiss", "Everyday Demons", "Human Glitches", and "Magnet Feet" will leave you belly laughing for the rest of your life.
title: Ridiculousness

overview: Second Noah is a television drama that was broadcast in the United States on ABC television from February 5, 1996 to June 8, 1997. The series stars Daniel Hugh Kelly as Noah Beckett, whose wife Jesse (Betsy Brantley) is a veterinarian at Busch Gardens in Florida. Noah is a former basketball coachwho is now a writer working on a second book, to be entitled The Ark, after his first effort has sold over 2,000,000 copies. Noah and Jesse have a tendency to take in both stray animals and stray children, having adopted eight.
title: Second Noah

overview: Ted Bullpitt, retired and single, moves into a retirement village.
title: Bullpitt!

overview: At his 80th birthday party, powerful patriarch Adolfo Novak gathers family and friends. Behind smiles lie decades of secrets, betrayals, and vengeance. The evening explodes, revealing a truth more shocking than anyone suspected.
title: El Homenaje

overview: Three women in their forties deal with midlife chaos: addiction, career struggles, and marriage to a wealthy older man. As one friend's life unravels, their longtime bond faces its biggest challenge.
title: Se tiene que morir mucha gente

overview: In a town where strict rules shape students into their "best selves," a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly "need" them. Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unravelling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.
title: Bloody Smart

overview: Drop straight into comedic chaos as stand-up funny woman Urzila Carlson ricochets between live stand-up and bombastic sketches in her first stand-up comedy sketch show.
title: Urzila

overview: The series' protagonist, Sverre Fjeld comes from Elverum and after graduating police college takes up a position at Stovner Police. Out on patrol he comes into contact with Trude, who through her ex-husband is drawn into a criminal environment. Eventually he begins to engage more than healthy to help the young woman and her little daughter Sara to get a better life. When Sverre gets caught between his conscience and the law, he makes a fateful choice. This starts a chain of eventsand the problems pile up for him. Meanwhile waiting at home in Elverum is his school sweetheart and fiance Randi preparing for their wedding oblivious to all that is going on with Sverre.
title: Svarte Penger, Hvite Løgner

overview: Happylou moves to Cebu in order to help her family who lives beside a train track. She also starts searching for her father that she has never met. She will eventually meet the people that will give answers to her lifelong questions.
title: Inday will always love you

overview: Shitake will travel to the Philippines to find a new right-hand man for the hated Emperor Takeshi. Watch Takeshi's Castle and bet on the players amidst the antics and fun in and out of the prepared games.
title: Takeshi's Castle Philippines

overview: The friendship between two royal dancers is shattered because of a love that goes beyond friendship.
title: The Bangkok Red Opera

overview: In 2012 Madrid, in the midst of an economic crisis, Marcos, an unscrupulous veteran con artist, runs into Juan, a broke young man who can barely support his family. What starts as a 24-hour partnership to pull off small scams ends up becoming the heist of their lives: selling legendary counterfeit stamps, the Nueve reinas, as genuine to a ruthless tycoon.
title: Nueve reinas

overview: Celebrity singers, actors and sports stars take on the ultimate test.
title: SAS: Aus v Eng

overview: Young couples learn to buy and maintain their first homes with help from Zack and Camille Dettmore and their team of real estate, mortgage, legal, and construction experts
title: This First House

overview: Glory brings to the fore a fractured family forced back together. Raghubir Singh, a formidable boxing coach driven by an obsession with Olympic glory, struggles to hold together a legacy that is slowly unraveling under the weight of strained relationships. His sons Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh to uncover the truth behind the brutal assault on their sister Gudiya and the mysterious death of a rising Olympic boxing star — Nihal Singh.
title: Glory

overview: In 1991, Vicky Hamilton and Dinah McNicol vanished six months apart. The cases stayed cold until 2006, when Angelika Kluk's murder led to an arrest as DNA linked the perpetrator to all three.
title: Snatched

overview: Two people from very different backgrounds fall in love and decide to get married, but not without their parents blessings. Three days before the wedding they introduce each other with their respective parents and all hell breaks lose.
title: Bang Baaja Baaraat

overview: Donny Osmond presents Identity, a game show testing contestants' people-watching prowess. Participants try to match up 12 strangers with their secret identities to win big cash prizes.
title: Identity

overview: A rising social media star named Eligio Bishop, also known as "NatureBoy," used his platforms to recruit followers into a group he called Carbon Nation, encouraging them to abandon their families and join his vision.
title: The Cult of NatureBoy

overview: Hidden Beneath the Cities uncovers the extraordinary worlds lying just below modern urban centers. Beneath the streets of stone, soil and concrete exist hidden realms shaped by survival, ritual and imagination. Uncovers the extraordinary worlds that exist beneath major urban centres, from the tombs and wartime shelters of Naples to the manmade Royston Cave in Hertfordshire, England.
title: Hidden Beneath the Cities

overview: Tiny Tunes, presented by Lisa Kelly, brings classic nursery rhymes to life as deaf and hearing children sing, sign and explore the great outdoors together.
title: Tiny Tunes

overview: Stephen Nolan joins officers from the Police Service of Northern Ireland as they patrol the streets of Belfast in Peelers: The PSNI – For Real. The series reflects the realities of 24/7 policing and its many challenges – including street disorder, substance abuse and domestic violence. It also gives viewers a revealing sense of what it's like to be a police officer and the teamwork that's required in fast-changing and often uncertain situations.
title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real

overview: Comedian Craig Ferguson unpacks America's chaotic, triumphant and controversial 250-year journey of independence. Now, in the country he calls home, he explores its freedoms, contradictions, quirks, and what it means to be American today.
title: Craig Ferguson: American on Purpose

overview: Mankind Decoded reveals the gripping story of how 12 surprising forces shaped human civilization and helped make us who we are today. Lust for Luxury depicts the hunger of ordinary people for the luxuries of the rich, and how this has impacted history, from the obsession with silk to the fall of Constantinople and the industrial revolution.
title: Mankind Decoded

overview: The area where our heroes are working will undergo a rigorous test. The Supreme Inquisition must certify prosecutors and lawyers, and the one with the minimum score must be sent to the Thought Sector. Needless to say, independent and ironic Andrey and Veniamin manage to instantly turn the Supreme Inspector against themselves?
title: Небесный суд. Продолжение

overview: For 30 years, Katie Price has turned her private life into public spectacle. The nation thinks they know her - but Katie Price: Nothing to Hide will challenge them to look again. Katie Price: Nothing to Hide, a Sky Original four-part series brings a documentary lens to Katie's story, combining extraordinary unseen footage with first-time testimony to deliver a revealing portrait of one of Britain's most enduring celebrity figures. This archive-led retrospective goes beyond the headlines, with intimate access to Katie and those closest to her - some for decades, some for pivotal moments, and some whose stories have never been told - to candidly examine the consequences of placing herself, and those around her, at the centre of public attention. Since emerging as her alter ego ‘Jordan' on Page 3 of The Sun in 1996, Katie Price has become one of the most photographed women of her generation. Her life has played out across newspapers, magazines, reality television and social media - from marriages, motherhood and multi-million pound contracts to scandal, cosmetic surgery, bankruptcy and betrayal.
title: Katie Price: Nothing to Hide

overview: From 2-year-old to teen, this coming-of-age drama based on true events follows the story of Alex Hanscombe who witnessed his mother's murder in 1992.
title: The Witness

overview: One of the main states of Curtiana is Talig, whose throne was seized by the Ollar dynasty. The legitimate heir takes refuge in the city-state of Agaris, where the head of the local church rules. He dreams of overthrowing the Ollars one day and reclaiming the throne that rightfully belongs to him.
title: Aeterna

overview: New Zealand's newest spies - and the only three who applied - are tasked with protecting our nation from incoming threats, most notably those noisy neighbours in Australia.
title: New Zealand Spy

overview: Six celebrities, each with little to no pottery experience will brave the clay and take to the wheel in a series of bold ceramic challenges.
title: The Great Celebrity Pottery Throw Down

overview: A young woman gets transported back almost 200 years by a spell through a magical vessel where she meets her soulmate and uncovers secrets that connect to the future.
title: Phetra Naruemit

overview: "Khem Sorn Plai" is the story of a beautiful girl named Cherd, who is stuck in a marriage with Dr. Ruengboon in an overseas country. In a loveless marriage, she finds herself falling for, Lanna, a Thai student who has come overseas to study. However, Dr. Ruengboon refuses to give Cherd a divorce and this keeps her bound to him unwillingly. Eventually, Lanna returns to Thailand and begins a new life by marrying Yaowayod, a young woman who is perfect in both looks and social status — and most of all was chosen for him by his mother. Despite having a sweet wife, Lanna can not forget Cherd and continues to keep the dazzling girl in his heart silently. When Dr. Ruengboon discovers that Lanna has gotten married, he finally divorces Cherd and so she too returns to Thailand and begins a new life. However, despite many young men ready to peruse her, she still holds a lit candle for Lanna — unable to forget him. And what of Lanna, who expresses the desire to get together with Cherd again, while not wanting to break up with his wife Yaowayod? The hidden needle in this story is the expression of passions in young men and women and how Cherd, after a long period of being misguided, decides to be free of the debt of the word "love".
title: Trouble Souls

overview: A teen travels to 1892 Philippines, posing as her ancestor to stop a tragedy. Her journey through time reveals deeper truths about destiny, sacrifice, and timeless love.
title: I Love You Since 1892

overview: Elite plastic surgeon Do Jiui has his perfect life turned upside down when he's unexpectedly sent to the remote island of Pyeondongdo as a public health doctor. Surrounded by the sea, the island is more than just isolation for him, as past trauma has turned the ocean into an unknowable terror and a massive prison. Intrusive locals and grotesque bugs turn life into a living hell for the city man. Amid it all, a mysterious nurse, Yuk Hari, appears. Hiding secrets behind her gentle smile, she always seems to be nearby when Jiui is overwhelmed by his fear of the sea. As the two become entangled on the small island, can Jiui overcome his past and escape safely?
title: Doctor on the Edge

overview: From the producers of MTV's hit series, Nitro Circus, come Thrillbillies; an unscripted all-action series that follows a wily crew of athletes and stuntmen who test the laws of logic through a series of entertaining mishaps and mayhem. Each episode is pure fun as Cam, Crum, and the rest of the Thrillbillies live out their inner Evel Knievel.
title: Thrillbillies

overview: Twenty years ago, Paul "Cope" Copeland's sister, Camille, vanished from a summer camp in the woods, a loss that tore his family apart. Now a top barrister and devoted single father to ten-year-old daughter Cami, Cope appears to have rebuilt his life. But when the body of a man turns up — twenty years after he was supposedly murdered alongside Camille — Cope becomes convinced his sister may have made it out of the woods alive too. Determined to uncover the truth, Cope begins a search for answers, unearthing years of lies, cover-ups, and family secrets that threaten to destroy everything he has built.
title: Harlan Coben's The Woods

overview: Lovesick follows the intense affair between two people whose lives unexpectedly intertwine. Annika, a renowned breast cancer surgeon, has just received her own cancer diagnosis. Her new patient, Nate, is a promising politician. The series explores their interwoven lives, delving into themes of love, sex, illness, death, family, children, health, medicine, and the meaning of life — all while Annika is simultaneously undergoing breast cancer treatment.
title: Lovesick

overview: Comedian Pete Davidson welcomes friends and famous faces for an intimate weekly hangout at the most exclusive venue in New York — his garage.
title: The Pete Davidson Show

overview: The celebrity version of the original Big Brother series.
title: Big Brother VIP

overview: Lu Sinian, a divine guardian of the Heavenly Lake, falls in love with Yao, the lake's spirit. To save her, he steals a sacred medicine and is cursed to endure ninety-nine lifetimes of reincarnation. For thousands of years, Yao waits by the Heavenly Lake, meeting and falling in love with him again and again in every new life. In his final reincarnation, Lu Sinian dies while sealing a water demon alongside Yao. Moved by their unwavering love, the Queen Mother of the West grants him life once more, allowing the two to finally remain together as mortal lovers.
title: Millennium Love

overview: Sean Hannity interviews political figures and newsmakers and offers his own perspective.
title: Hannity

overview: This story tells of a middle-aged couple who, on the verge of divorce, embark on a "cooling-off period trip" to re-examine each other and rediscover their initial love. The series uses a narrative style that interweaves reality and memories to depict a marriage that progresses from passionate companionship to growing estrangement, and ultimately, reconciliation.
title: A Journey Back to Us

overview: Seeking to avenge his father, Knut the Great defied all expectations to rise to power. Through cunning attacks, fierce battles, and strategic alliances, he conquered England, Norway, Sweden, and Denmark. He forged an unprecedented union between Nordic and Anglo-Saxon lands, establishing a maritime empire that stretched from the North Sea to the Atlantic Ocean, via the Baltic Sea. This success allowed him to secure lasting political and cultural control over Northern Europe, becoming the ruler of the largest empire ever created by the Vikings. A story of war, blood, and power, Knut: The Viking Emperor dives into the life of a military genius whose thirst for glory left an indelible mark on the history of Europe, brought to life through fully AI-generated reconstructions in collaboration with historical advisors.
title: Knut: The Viking Emperor

overview: Jomkwan and her mother lived a poor life because her grandmother rejected them. Then fortune came into her life when she was adopted by a millionaire. Now she's come back to take revenge on the family that rejected her.
title: Behind the Throne

overview: 1,000 lbs of dynamite, a $3 million ransom, a casino facing destruction - and as the FBI races against the clock, each step reveals dark secrets. An outrageous true crime saga.
title: This Is a Bomb: The Nevada Casino Heist

overview: Noi and Pia were raised by Yen but were absolutely opposite in character. Noi was all goodness and graciousness and Pia was malicious and wicked. Neither girl knew of her heritage, or background. Until Yen took both of them to Bangkok to meet her ex-employer, Uthai, and his wife, Wanee and discover an unusual truth.
title: The Vengeance

overview: Fresh air, good vibes, and woodsmoked wonders! Jamie Oliver shows us how to get outside, get cooking and get those flavours and textures that the kitchen just can't match.
title: Jamie's Ultimate BBQ

overview: As he battles for a final triumph on the court, Rafael Nadal opens up like never before about what shaped one of the greatest tennis careers of all time.
title: Rafa

overview: When America's beloved First Lady is abducted and replaced by a Russian double, both women must fight to survive - one navigating captivity in Siberia, the other infiltrating the White House to sabotage NATO during the G7 Summit.
title: The Second Lady

overview: The only daily news program focused exclusively on technology, innovation and the future of business from San Francisco. Hosted by Emily Chang.
title: Bloomberg Technology

overview: Two young men chase impossible dreams in the ruthless world of real estate sales. Prashant, driven by love, longs to be a great actor, while Jimmy, fueled by vengeance, seeks to be Delhi's richest man. Both are obsessive dreamers with opposite paths. When fate unites them, they clash with each other and a brutal world that spares no one who dares to dream.
title: Sapne Vs Everyone

overview: Bourbon Island, 1806. After a devastating cyclone, Charles Bellevue's plantation is ravaged. Ruined, he has no choice but to sell his land. But his slaves fear being sold and separated. Among them, Isaac refuses his fate: he has just discovered that Charles Bellevue is not only his master. He is also his father.
title: Enchaines

overview: Lu Feng, the young heir of a noble family, and Cheng Yichen, the exemplary student, fall in love during their student years. Separated by their parents' opposition, the two meet again years later. Lu Feng, who wants to move forward with his love, and Cheng Yichen, who is concerned about his surroundings. Lu Feng's obsession with Yichen ultimately leads to a tragedy...
title: Double Helix

overview: Travis Japan embarks on a summer road trip through the Rocky Mountains in North America. Divided into teams, one hits the road by RV, the other dives into local culture. With new horizons to explore and heartfelt connections to make, this road trip promises to be unlike any other.
title: Travis Japan Summer Vacation!! In the USA

overview: This Is Poly takes a first-of-its-kind look at the world of polyamory, following the lives of five wildly different polycules, interconnected groups of people in polyamorous relationships. As they build lives and families outside traditional norms, the series dives into the emotional realities of jealousy, commitment, communication, and trust, testing every rule of love and redefining what it means to be a family.
title: This Is Poly

overview: CNN Newsroom with John Berman and Poppy Harlow also known as the CNN Newsroom, is an American news program on CNN/US. Broadcasting throughout the week, Newsroom features live and taped news reports, in addition to analysis from experts on the issues being covered, and headlines throughout each hour. The program tends to focus on softer news than their hard news primetime lineup. The program is the standard "brand" for general rolling-news programming for the network, originating from their headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia.
title: CNN Newsroom with John Berman and Poppy Harlow

overview: The fun-filled lives of the growing number of British and Irish expats who are turning their backs on grey skies and rising living costs at home and seeking a fresh start in America's Sunshine State.
title: Escape to Florida

overview: Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter marks the closing chapter of one of the most influential reality franchises of all time. For 15 years, Love & Hip Hop built stars, sparked conversation, and helped define the modern reality television era. Now, cast, creators, and cultural voices come together for a definitive look back – celebrating its impact, unpacking its most talked-about moments, confronting the controversies that shaped the conversation, and examining its legacy.
title: Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter

overview: FNC's signature weekend newscast, FOX Report with Jon Scott, anchored by Jon Scott, highlights the latest developments and breaking news in the U.S. and around the globe.
title: FOX Report with Jon Scott
Dang Shi Zhi Zhi Dao Qing Qing

overview: Zhong Xiran waited in vain at the airport for her ex-boyfriend Huo Xin to elope with her. At her most helpless moment, Qi Sinian, who had an engagement with her, appeared and told her that Huo Xin had given her up for a million dollars. Later, due to her family business falling into trouble, Zhong Xiran and Qi Sinian entered into a marriage of convenience, becoming a couple on the surface. After marriage, Zhong Xiran always believed that Qi Sinian did not love her and had another love interest, and their relationship was more about possession and submission. It wasn't until four years later, when her ex-boyfriend Huo Xin returned to the country and pursued Zhong Xiran openly, causing a series of conflicts and tests, that the long-buried secrets gradually came to light—it turned out that this marriage was the culmination of Qi Sinian's eleven-year-long secret love.Adapted from the free novel "The Eleventh Year of Secretly Loving Her" by You Xiang Ru Gu.
title: Perfect Match

overview: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.
title: The Grand-ish Tour
